source.name: About FIBA: "Go-time for FIBA and Asia's biggest natural mineral water brand Ganten with Global Partnership extension"
source.quote: Asia's leading natural mineral water brand, Ganten, has enjoyed principal commercial rights and exclusivity in the water category across all FIBA competitions since 2018.

note: FIBA Global Partner since 2018, with exclusivity in the water category; extended to the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027.
